items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And Bill started out with Tommy Dorsey when Bill,

ctx.x: Just tell us… Some people don’t know who Bill is.

Bill Finegan probably is best known for having been half of the Sauter–Finegan band. Bill Finegan and Eddie Sauter. They… Eddie had written for Benny Goodman’s band and all kinds of great bands. And Bill started out with Tommy Dorsey when Bill,

he was still a teenager, I think. He wrote a bunch of things for Dorsey and… and I think he called me about a record date or something years later. I think he… oh, he came in to hear me with Sonny Rollins. In fact, Bill lived in the Village right down near Washington Square there. So we got to be good friends. And it’s funny. Right up to the very end, Bill would call me… just two or three years ago, and we would never talk about music. He’d say, “Hey, Jim, I got one for ya.” And he’d tell me something…
